title: だ
shortExplanation: Marks a plain statement that something is something.

title: です
shortExplanation: Marks a polite statement that something is something.

title: は
shortExplanation: Marks what the sentence is talking about.

title: も
shortExplanation: Adds another matching thing or person to the statement.

title: これ
shortExplanation: Points to a thing near the speaker.

title: それ
shortExplanation: Points to a thing near the listener.

title: あれ
shortExplanation: Points to a thing away from both speaker and listener.

title: の
shortExplanation: Links two nouns so the first describes or owns the second.

title: いい
shortExplanation: Shows the special common adjective meaning good.

title: い-Adjective
shortExplanation: Names the class of adjectives that usually end in い.

title: な-Adjective
shortExplanation: Names the class of adjective-like nouns that use な before nouns.

title: か
shortExplanation: Turns a statement into a question.

title: が
shortExplanation: Marks the subject or the thing being identified.

title: よ
shortExplanation: Adds a small push, as if telling the listener new information.

title: ね
shortExplanation: Invites agreement or shared feeling from the listener.

title: る-Verb
shortExplanation: Names verbs whose dictionary form commonly ends in る and attach ます by dropping る.

title: う-Verb
shortExplanation: Names verbs whose endings shift across the あ/い/う/え/お rows.

title: を
shortExplanation: Marks the thing that receives the action.

title: ます
shortExplanation: Makes a verb polite in non-past statements.

title: る-Verbない
shortExplanation: The negative form of an ichidan verb.

title: う-Verbない
shortExplanation: The negative form of a godan verb.

title: と
shortExplanation: Connects nouns as a complete list.

title: ここ
shortExplanation: Points to the place near the speaker.

title: そこ
shortExplanation: Points to the place near the listener.

title: あそこ
shortExplanation: Points to a place away from both speaker and listener.

title: で
shortExplanation: Marks where an action happens.

title: に
shortExplanation: Marks a location, time, destination, or target.

title: か
shortExplanation: Places a choice between two nouns or phrases.

title: と
shortExplanation: Marks the person or thing someone acts with.

title: でしょう
shortExplanation: Softens a guess or asks for agreement politely.

title: だろう
shortExplanation: Softens a guess or asks for agreement plainly.

title: がある
shortExplanation: Says that a thing exists or that someone has it.

title: がいる
shortExplanation: Says that a living thing exists or remains somewhere.

title: この
shortExplanation: Places this before a noun near the speaker.

title: その
shortExplanation: Places that before a noun near the listener.

title: あの
shortExplanation: Places that before a noun away from both speaker and listener.

title: んです・のです
shortExplanation: Adds an explanatory or clarifying feeling to a sentence.
displayPattern: Plain form + んです / のです

title: の
shortExplanation: Makes a casual explanatory question.

title: い-Adjectiveた
shortExplanation: The past form of an i-adjective.

title: のは・のが
shortExplanation: Turns a verb phrase into a noun-like subject or topic.

title: い-Adjective + Noun
shortExplanation: Lets an i-adjective describe the noun after it.

title: な-Adjective + Noun
shortExplanation: Uses な to let a na-adjective describe the noun after it.

title: へ行く
shortExplanation: Uses へ with a motion verb to show the destination.

title: する
shortExplanation: Uses する as the basic verb do or make.

title: くる
shortExplanation: Uses くる as the basic motion verb come.

title: る-Verbた
shortExplanation: The past form of an ichidan verb.

title: う-Verbた
shortExplanation: The past form of a godan verb.

title: 好き
shortExplanation: States that someone likes something.

title: 嫌い
shortExplanation: States that someone dislikes something.

title: のが好き
shortExplanation: Says that someone likes doing an action.

title: がある + Noun
shortExplanation: Lets がある describe a following noun as having something.

title: くない
shortExplanation: The non-past negative form of an i-adjective.

title: で
shortExplanation: Marks the tool, method, or material used for an action.

title: ので
shortExplanation: Gives a reason in a softer explanatory way.

title: から
shortExplanation: Gives a reason before the result.

title: から
shortExplanation: Marks the starting point in time or place.

title: けど・だけど
shortExplanation: Links two ideas with a soft contrast.

title: が
shortExplanation: Links two ideas with a contrast.

title: る-Verbなかった
shortExplanation: The past negative form of an ichidan verb.

title: う-Verbなかった
shortExplanation: The past negative form of a godan verb.

title: ～て
shortExplanation: Links actions or clauses with the te-form.

title: ～ている
meaning: is doing / is in a state
shortExplanation: Shows an action or state continuing now.

title: へ
shortExplanation: Marks the direction someone or something moves toward.

title: ～に行く
shortExplanation: Shows going somewhere in order to do an action.

title: 誰
shortExplanation: Asks about a person.

title: なぜ
shortExplanation: Asks for a reason.

title: どうして
shortExplanation: Asks why something happened or how it came about.

title: なんで
shortExplanation: Casually asks for a reason.

title: い-Adjective + です
shortExplanation: Lets an i-adjective end a polite sentence.

title: な-Adjective + だ
shortExplanation: Lets a na-adjective end a plain sentence with だ.

title: だった・でした
shortExplanation: Makes だ or です past tense.
displayPattern: Noun + だった / でした

title: じゃない
shortExplanation: Makes a casual negative statement that something is not something.

title: じゃなかった
shortExplanation: Makes a casual past negative statement.

title: くなかった
shortExplanation: The past negative form of an i-adjective.
displayPattern: い-adjective stem + くなかった

title: と
shortExplanation: Marks quoted speech or thought.

title: って
shortExplanation: Casually marks quoted speech or a topic being brought up.

title: Verb (Non-Past)
shortExplanation: Uses dictionary or polite form for present and future meaning.

title: ～た + Noun
shortExplanation: Lets a past-tense verb describe a following noun.

title: が・の
shortExplanation: Allows の to mark a subject inside some noun-modifying clauses.

title: の
shortExplanation: Uses の in place of an understood noun.

title: な
shortExplanation: A blunt command telling someone not to do something.

title: だけ
shortExplanation: Limits the statement to only that thing.

title: どれ
shortExplanation: Asks which thing among three or more.

title: どこ
shortExplanation: Asks about a place.

title: どの
shortExplanation: Comes before a noun to ask which one.

title: ～ている
shortExplanation: Shows the current state left by a completed action.

title: ～てから
shortExplanation: Says one action happens after another is done.

title: ～て
shortExplanation: Links actions in sequence with the te-form.

title: もう
shortExplanation: Shows that something is already true, or no longer true with negatives.

title: まだ
shortExplanation: Shows that a state continues or something has not happened yet.

title: まだ～ていません
shortExplanation: Says that an action has not happened yet.
displayPattern: まだ + Verbて + いません

title: ～てもいい
shortExplanation: Says doing something is allowed or okay.

title: たい
shortExplanation: Attaches to a verb stem to show wanting to do it.

title: たり～たりする
shortExplanation: Lists sample actions rather than every action.
displayPattern: Verbたり + Verbたり + する

title: けっこう
shortExplanation: Adds a fairly strong amount or degree.

title: たくさん
shortExplanation: Shows a large amount or number.

title: 前に
shortExplanation: Marks something before in time or in front in space.

title: くらい
shortExplanation: Marks an approximate amount.

title: Noun + まで
shortExplanation: Marks the endpoint for a time, place, or range.

title: Verb + まで
shortExplanation: Marks the endpoint as the time when an action happens.

title: 過ぎる
shortExplanation: Shows that an action or quality goes too far.

title: にする
shortExplanation: Shows choosing something or making it into a state.

title: になる・くなる
shortExplanation: Shows a change into a new state.

title: の中で～が一番
shortExplanation: Compares a group and picks the most or best one.
displayPattern: Group + の中で + Nounが一番

title: より～の方が
shortExplanation: Compares two things and says which side is more.

title: 何か・何も
shortExplanation: Combines 何 with か or も to mean something, anything, or nothing with negatives.

title: 誰か・どこか・誰も・どこも
shortExplanation: Combines question words with か or も for indefinite or negative meanings.

title: ましょう
shortExplanation: Suggests doing something together.

title: ましょうか
shortExplanation: Offers or suggests doing something politely.

title: ませんか
shortExplanation: Invites someone politely to do something.

title: ～てもいい
shortExplanation: Says doing an action is allowed.

title: ～てください
shortExplanation: Makes a polite request for someone to do an action.

title: ～ないでください
shortExplanation: Politely asks someone not to do an action.

title: ～てはいけない
shortExplanation: Says that doing an action is not allowed.
displayPattern: Verbて + は + いけない

title: なくてはいけない
shortExplanation: Says that not doing something is not okay.
displayPattern: Verbなくて + は + いけない

title: なくてはならない
shortExplanation: Says that not doing something will not do.
displayPattern: Verbなくて + は + ならない

title: ～た方がいい
shortExplanation: Advises that doing an action is better.

title: ない方がいい
meaning: should not do / better not to
shortExplanation: Advises that not doing an action is better.

title: なくちゃ・なきゃ
shortExplanation: A casual short way to say that something must be done.

title: や
shortExplanation: Lists examples without saying the list is complete.

title: ～たことがある
shortExplanation: Says someone has experienced doing something before.

title: ～ている
shortExplanation: Shows repeated action over a period of time.

title: ～て・～で
shortExplanation: Links adjectives or nouns in one description.

title: ～て
shortExplanation: Links qualities or states together.

title: のが下手
shortExplanation: Says someone is not skillful at an action.

title: のが上手
shortExplanation: Says someone is skillful at an action.

title: Adjective + のは
shortExplanation: Turns an adjective description into a noun-like phrase.

title: あげる
shortExplanation: Shows giving from the speaker side or in-group toward someone else.
displayPattern: Giver + は/が + Receiverに + Objectを + あげる

title: くれる
shortExplanation: Shows someone giving to the speaker side or in-group.
displayPattern: Giver + が + Objectを + くれる

title: もらう
shortExplanation: Shows receiving something from someone.
displayPattern: Receiver + は/が + Giverに + Objectを + もらう

title: けれども
shortExplanation: Links two ideas with a polite or softer contrast.

title: つもりだ
shortExplanation: States a plan or intention.
